phases.title: 1. Ready
phases.text: Carriage cocked and held by the sear, dart seated against the pusher, rail down at 4 deg. Motor stopped: the wiper worm is self locking.

phases.title: 2. Fire: motor backward
phases.text: Bearing A locks: the program gear turns. Its cam lifts the rail on the frame roller, 4 to 35 deg, slowly: the rail carries the program gear round the pinion. The reel rotor turns backward too, which pulls the pickup pin in: the line is free.

phases.title: 3. Shot
phases.text: The trip cord from the base goes taut as the rail lifts, pulls the clevis sear down until its hook clears the keel, the springs pull the carriage 208 mm in 33 ms. Dart leaves at 10.7 m/s.

phases.title: 4. Flight
phases.text: End pull: the spool never turns, the line peels off its front over the still rotor and out of the eye (about 0.8 N). Range 8.4 m, time of flight 1.20 s.

phases.title: 5. Landing
phases.text: Nose ballast keeps it nose first; it drops onto its belly. The tail cap end carries the tether.

phases.title: 6. Anchor (dart)
phases.text: KEDGE on its own: kick leg swings 202 deg over the nose and screws the foot in, then the pods swing down 42.25 deg while the counter rotating augers drill in. Shown 4x faster.

phases.title: 7. Tow (self recovery)
phases.text: Motor forward: bearing A freewheels, the backstop holds the launcher. The rotor's drag disc pushes the pickup pin out, it catches the line and lays it on the still spool. Tension held at the 20 N limit. Shown 10x faster.

phases.title: 8. Release (dart)
phases.text: Drills unscrew, pods fold up, kick leg swings back over the top. Shown 4x faster.

phases.title: 9. Cock: motor backward
phases.text: Program gear teeth pick up the rack and draw the carriage back 208 mm against the springs (42 to 192 N). The keel lead-in pushes the sear hook down, the spring snaps it up in front of the keel, the carriage runs about 1.4 mm onto it. Stops in the dwell before the lift.

phases.title: 10. Retrieve: motor forward
phases.text: The reel winds the dart back tail first; it is dragged up the muzzle onto the cradle and slides back until its tail meets the pusher (seated switch / current spike stops the motor). Shown 12x faster.

phases.title: 11. Ready again
phases.text: Seated, cocked, rail down. Next shot needs only the motor backward. No hand operation.
